gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-stack-sans-headli: Wide-tracked letters with crossbars as heavy as the stems give Stentiga a spread-out, luxurious look. Stack Sans Headline sits beneath it, monoline and crisp.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stentiga spreads its letters out with a refined, luxurious hush. Stack Sans Notch sits next to it looking big-bodied and rod-straight, so the two feel like silk beside steel.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-stack-sans-text: Stentiga stretches out, refined and luxurious, with generous spacing between its letters. Stack Sans Text then moves along in a marker-like line with big lowercase forms, so a long passage feels modern and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sulphur-point: Stentiga is spaced wide and dressed up, with doorway-wide letter openings. Its strength is display polish, while Sulphur Point does the plainer work, with a steady marker-like line and bulky lowercase that stays easy to follow.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-tiktok-sans: Stentiga spaces its letters generously and never adds a calligraphic swell to any downstroke, which gives it a refined, luxurious feel. TikTok Sans reads tall and modern.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-ubuntu-sans: Refined and luxurious, Stentiga spreads out its letters, though shrink it small and that wide tracking would lose its grandeur. Ubuntu Sans has round, pipe-like strokes.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-vend-sans: Wide, stately and a little grand: Stentiga spaces its letters out with crossbars as thick as its stems. Stentiga is best at that polished display, while Vend Sans fills the line.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-yaldevi: Spread-out and luxurious, Stentiga cuts every line to a single depth, like an engraver's tool. Yaldevi then offers outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right.
gen-dafont-teutonic-fs-rowan: Rowan opens friendly and literary, with generous curves and thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. But Teutonic, flat and stencil-cut, would feel cramped if made small.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-abeezee: Gaping-mouthed e shapes and short ascenders over big bowls make Visitor feel like a pixel-era screen. ABeeZee, a plain sans with a high mean line and open terminals, keeps the text approachable.
